research.website_note: The supplied site is Linear’s official product website and presents Linear’s product and customer stories.

strategy.observation: Linear describes AI workflows as central to its product and supports workflows shared by people and AI agents.
strategy.offer_link: Recruiting and scheduling customer interviews could help Linear’s product team hear how customers work with human-and-agent workflows and gather input for product decisions.
hypotheses: Linear may be looking to understand how customers use these shared workflows and where they need improvement.
A Head of Product may be involved in finding reliable ways to recruit relevant customers for those conversations.
strategy.angle: Since Linear supports workflows shared by people and AI agents, I wondered whether customer interviews could help your team explore how those workflows are working for users.
strategy.fit_reason: Customer interview recruiting is directly relevant to product development, and Linear’s stated focus on AI workflows gives the offer a concrete product area to connect to; the facts do not establish a current research need.

draft.subject: Customer interviews on AI workflows
draft.body:
Since Linear supports workflows shared by people and AI agents, I wondered whether interviews could help your team understand how those workflows are working for users.

I recruit and schedule customer interview participants for product teams, so they can hear directly from users when making product decisions.

Are you currently recruiting users to talk about where these shared workflows fit into their day?
